verdict.rationale: Cactus ships an official CLI. The GitHub repo documents installing it with `brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus` and running `cactus run`, `cactus convert`, and `cactus benchmark`, and the platform docs list the CLI as a way to run hosted work with an API key alongside coding agents. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference, documented agent-oriented features (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive auth flows), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and clarity on whether the hosted-platform CLI is the same tool as the engine CLI (`cactus convert` is also marked experimental).
